title: MultiScopeVerificationFixture
description: Scopes `verifyTaxonomyScopes` verifies against one repository read: `scopes` (a clean leaf, a directory without a registered kind, a scope nested inside another listed scope) at every test level, `moving` (scopes that plan a move, exercising the shared incoming-reference scan) at the exhaustive level. The law: each multi-scope verdict equals `verifyTaxonomy` of that scope alone.
